programName: Phát âm & Trọng âm tiếng Anh

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Noun] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
Put the books on the TAble.
The TAble is made of wood.
We eat dinner at the TAble.
quizzes: Please set the dishes on the __________ for dinner.
The big round __________ in the kitchen is made of wood.
She put her bag on the __________ next to the door.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Noun] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
Can I have a glass of WAter?
Drink more WAter every day.
The WAter in the lake is cold.
quizzes: She poured a cold glass of __________ for her sister.
Plants need sunlight and __________ to grow.
The __________ in the swimming pool was very clear and clean.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Adjective] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
The children look very HAPpy.
She is HAPpy when she plays with her friends.
A HAPpy face is contagious.
quizzes: He smiled and looked very __________ when he got the gift.
She is always __________ and friendly in the classroom.
Seeing my family always makes me feel very __________.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Adjective] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
She is very BUSy with homework.
Are you BUSy this evening?
The market is always BUSy on weekends.
quizzes: I can't talk now, I am very __________ with my project.
The teacher was __________ marking the students' tests.
He is always __________ on Monday mornings.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Adjective - EXCEPTION] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Ngoại lệ: từ bắt đầu bằng 'a' - trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
She sat aLONE in the room.
He walked home aLONE.
Don't leave the baby aLONE.
quizzes: She was left __________ in the house while her parents went shopping.
I don't like staying __________ when it is dark outside.
The puppy looked sad and __________ in the corner of the room.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Adjective - EXCEPTION] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Ngoại lệ: từ bắt đầu bằng 'a' - trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
The baby is aSLEEP.
He fell aSLEEP on the sofa.
She was aSLEEP when I called.
quizzes: Please be quiet! The baby is __________.
He was so tired that he fell __________ in less than five minutes.
The cat is __________ on the warm mat near the heater.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Verb] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Động từ/Giới từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
Let's beGIN the lesson.
The show will beGIN at 8 o'clock.
When will you beGIN your homework?
quizzes: The teacher asked us to __________ reading from page 10.
The movie will __________ at exactly seven o'clock.
I will __________ my new hobby of painting next weekend.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Verb] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Động từ/Giới từ 2 âm tiết: trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
I want to inVITE you to my party.
She inVITED all her classmates.
He did not inVITE me to his birthday.
quizzes: She will __________ all her friends to her birthday party.
He forgot to __________ his best friend to the celebration.
Did your teacher __________ the students to the school event?

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Verb - EXCEPTION] Stress on the 1st syllable. Ngoại lệ động từ: âm tiết 2 yếu hoặc có đuôi -en/-er/-ow/-ish/-y nên trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
Please OPen the window.
OPen your books to page 20.
Can you OPen the door for me?
quizzes: Please __________ the window to let some fresh air in.
The shop will __________ at nine o'clock every morning.
__________ your textbook and turn to page fifteen.

vocabularies.definition: [2-syllable Verb - EXCEPTION] Stress on the 1st syllable. Ngoại lệ động từ: đuôi -en nên trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
What did HAPpen?
Accidents HAPpen sometimes.
Something strange HAPpened last night.
quizzes: What will __________ if it rains during the sports day?
Strange things __________ in that old house at night.
Did anything interesting __________ while I was away?

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Noun] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết thứ 2 chứa âm /ə/ hoặc /ɪ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
This beach is like PARadise.
The garden looks like a PARadise.
For me, a library is a PARadise.
quizzes: The beautiful tropical island felt like a __________.
A garden full of flowers is her idea of __________.
The children called the playground their little __________.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Noun] Stress on the 1st syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết thứ 2 chứa âm /ə/ hoặc /ɪ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
Buy the medicine at the PHARmacy.
The PHARmacy is next to the hospital.
She works as a pharmacist at the PHARmacy.
quizzes: You can buy cough syrup at the __________ on the corner.
The doctor told me to go to the __________ to get my medicine.
Is there a __________ near this hospital?

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Noun] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối chứa âm yếu và âm tiết 2 chứa nguyên âm dài/đôi, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
I love mashed poTAto.
She peeled the poTAto carefully.
We grow poTAtoes in our garden.
quizzes: She made delicious mashed __________ for dinner.
Do you want __________ chips or rice with your meal?
He planted __________ seeds in the garden last spring.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Noun] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Danh từ/Tính từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối chứa âm yếu và âm tiết 2 chứa nguyên âm dài/đôi, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
The flood was a diSASter.
The fire was a major diSASter.
The broken computer was a diSASter for the project.
quizzes: The earthquake was a terrible __________ for the whole country.
Forgetting to save the file was a __________ for his report.
The heavy rain caused a __________ in the low-lying areas.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Verb] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Động từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối chứa nguyên âm ngắn và kết thúc bằng 1 phụ âm, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
Did you enCOUNter any problems?
We enCOUNtered a storm at sea.
He enCOUNtered his old teacher at the market.
quizzes: Did you __________ any difficulties while doing your homework?
The explorers __________ wild animals deep in the forest.
She was surprised to __________ her old neighbor at the mall.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Verb] Stress on the 2nd syllable. Động từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối chứa nguyên âm ngắn và kết thúc bằng 1 phụ âm, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
We need to deTERmine the cause.
The test will deTERmine your level.
She deTERmined that hard work was the key.
quizzes: The scientist tried to __________ the cause of the illness.
We need to __________ the best route to take.
The exam results will __________ which class he joins next year.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Verb] Stress on the 3rd (last) syllable. Động từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối chứa nguyên âm dài hoặc kết thúc bằng 2+ phụ âm, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết CUỐI.
vocabularies.example:
The clown enterTAINed the children.
She loves to enterTAIN guests.
He enterTAINed us with funny stories.
quizzes: The comedian did his best to __________ the large crowd.
She loves to __________ her guests with delicious food.
The magic tricks __________ all the children at the party.

vocabularies.definition: [3-syllable Verb] Stress on the 3rd (last) syllable. Động từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm tiết cuối kết thúc bằng 2+ phụ âm, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết CUỐI.
vocabularies.example:
I did not compreHEND the question.
She found it hard to compreHEND the lesson.
Please read it again to compreHEND it fully.
quizzes: It is difficult to __________ a lesson when you haven't read the textbook.
Did you fully __________ the instructions for the exam?
She had to read the paragraph twice to __________ its meaning.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ee] The suffix -ee carries the main stress. Hậu tố -ee nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
Do you aGREE with me?
I aGREE with your decision.
We all aGREE that teamwork is important.
quizzes: Do you __________ that we should start earlier?
Not everyone will __________ with your plan.
I __________ that learning English is very useful.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -eer] The suffix -eer carries the main stress. Hậu tố -eer nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
My father is an engiNEER.
She wants to become an engiNEER.
The engiNEER designed the bridge.
quizzes: He dreams of becoming a software __________ one day.
The __________ checked all the machines in the factory.
Her mother works as a civil __________ for the city.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ese] The suffix -ese carries the main stress. Hậu tố -ese nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
I am VietnaMESE.
She speaks VietnaMESE very well.
VietnaMESE food is delicious.
quizzes: __________ food is famous all over the world.
She is learning the __________ language.
He is proud to be __________ and loves his country.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ique] The suffix -ique carries the main stress. Hậu tố -ique nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
Everyone has a uNIQUE fingerprint.
Her style is very uNIQUE.
Each student has a uNIQUE talent.
quizzes: Her painting style is very __________ and special.
Every snowflake has a __________ pattern.
He has a __________ way of solving math problems.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -oo] The suffix -oo carries the main stress. Hậu tố -oo nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
Pandas love eating bamBOO.
BamBOO grows very fast.
We made furniture from bamBOO.
quizzes: Pandas love to eat __________ shoots.
__________ is a very strong and flexible material.
The forest has many tall __________ trees.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ain] The suffix -ain carries the main stress. Hậu tố -ain nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
She mainTAINs a healthy lifestyle.
We must mainTAIN the school grounds.
He mainTAINed his good grades all year.
quizzes: You need to __________ good habits to stay healthy.
The school hires workers to __________ the garden.
He worked hard to __________ his position on the team.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ic] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -ic. Hậu tố -ic làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
The ecoNOmic situation has improved.
She studied ecoNOmic geography.
EcoNOmic growth is important for a country.
quizzes: The country is facing an __________ crisis.
She is interested in __________ geography.
Good __________ policies help a country grow.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ial] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -ial. Hậu tố -ial làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
The flower is artiFIcial.
She wore artiFIcial jewels.
They made an artiFIcial lake in the park.
quizzes: She decorated the table with __________ flowers.
The lake in the city center is __________, not natural.
__________ intelligence is used in many modern devices.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ian] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -ian. Hậu tố -ian làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
She is a talented muSIcian.
Every muSIcian practices a lot.
He became a famous muSIcian.
quizzes: She is a talented __________ who plays the violin.
A great __________ always practices every single day.
He hopes to become a professional __________ one day.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -tion] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -tion. Hậu tố -tion làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
Can I get some inforMAtion?
The guide gave us useful inforMAtion.
This website has a lot of inforMAtion.
quizzes: Can you give me some __________ about the school trip?
The brochure contains useful __________ about the city.
I need more __________ before I can make a decision.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ious] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -ious. Hậu tố -ious làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
This cake is deLIcious!
She cooked a deLIcious meal.
The deLIcious smell came from the kitchen.
quizzes: The soup my grandmother makes is absolutely __________.
The smell of the __________ pizza filled the whole room.
Everything on the menu looks so __________!

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ity] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -ity. Hậu tố -ity làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
She has the aBIlity to learn quickly.
He showed great aBIlity in music.
Everyone has a special aBIlity.
quizzes: She has a natural __________ to make people feel at ease.
His __________ to solve problems quickly is impressive.
Everyone has a unique __________ that makes them special.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -logy] Stress falls on the syllable BEFORE -logy. Hậu tố -logy làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC nó.
vocabularies.example:
I love studying biOlogy.
BiOlogy is the science of living things.
She got an A in her biOlogy exam.
quizzes: __________ is the study of plants, animals, and all living things.
She got an excellent score on her __________ exam.
Our __________ teacher showed us a frog in class today.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -cy] Stress on the 3rd syllable from the end. Hậu tố -cy làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI LÊN.
vocabularies.example:
We live in a deMOcracy.
DeMOcracy means people choose their leaders.
Freedom is a key value of deMOcracy.
quizzes: In a __________, citizens vote to choose their leaders.
Many countries around the world practice __________.
She studied the history of __________ in university.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -graphy] Stress on the 3rd syllable from the end. Hậu tố -graphy làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI LÊN.
vocabularies.example:
She is learning phoTOgraphy.
PhoTOgraphy is her favourite hobby.
He is very talented in phoTOgraphy.
quizzes: She takes beautiful pictures because she loves __________.
He enrolled in a __________ class to learn how to take better photos.
__________ is a great hobby for people who love art.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -al] Stress on the 3rd syllable from the end. Hậu tố -al làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI LÊN.
vocabularies.example:
It is a NAtional holiday.
She won the NAtional spelling competition.
We sang the NAtional anthem together.
quizzes: We celebrate the __________ holiday with fireworks.
She won the __________ science competition last month.
Everyone stood up when the __________ anthem began.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ate] Stress on the 3rd syllable from the end. Hậu tố -ate làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI LÊN.
vocabularies.example:
We comMUnicate by email.
She comMUnicates clearly in English.
It is important to comMUnicate well.
quizzes: We use social media to __________ with friends far away.
It is important to __________ clearly when working in a team.
She learned English so she could __________ with tourists.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ize] Stress on the 3rd syllable from the end. Hậu tố -ize làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI LÊN.
vocabularies.example:
Did you REcognize her voice?
I REcognize this song.
He REcognized his old friend in the crowd.
quizzes: I can __________ her handwriting from a mile away.
Can you __________ the song from just a few notes?
He couldn't __________ his old friend after so many years.

vocabularies.definition: [Prefix un-] The prefix un- does NOT change the stress of the root word. Tiền tố un- KHÔNG làm thay đổi trọng âm của từ gốc: HAPpy → unHAPpy.
vocabularies.example:
She looked unHAPpy after the match.
He was unHAPpy with the result.
Don't be unHAPpy, things will get better.
quizzes: She was __________ because she didn't get the grade she wanted.
He looked __________ when he heard the bad news.
Don't be __________, let's find a solution together.

vocabularies.definition: [Prefix dis-] The prefix dis- does NOT change the stress of the root word. Tiền tố dis- KHÔNG làm thay đổi trọng âm của từ gốc: COver → disCOver.
vocabularies.example:
Scientists disCOver new things every day.
She disCOvered a beautiful waterfall.
He disCOvered his love for music.
quizzes: Scientists __________ new plants in the rainforest.
She was excited to __________ a hidden cave on the beach.
He __________ that he loved painting when he was ten years old.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -ment] The suffix -ment does NOT change the stress of the root word. Hậu tố -ment KHÔNG làm thay đổi trọng âm: aGREE → aGREEment.
vocabularies.example:
We reached an aGREEment.
Sign the aGREEment before the deadline.
They made an aGREEment to share the work.
quizzes: Both teams signed the __________ after a long discussion.
We came to an __________ about sharing the chores.
The two countries signed a peace __________ last year.

vocabularies.definition: [Suffix -less] The suffix -less does NOT change the stress of the root word. Hậu tố -less KHÔNG làm thay đổi trọng âm: MEANing → MEANingless.
vocabularies.example:
The argument became MEANingless.
His apology felt MEANingless.
Don't do MEANingless things with your time.
quizzes: A word without context can sound completely __________.
His excuse seemed __________ after what had happened.
Don't waste your time doing __________ tasks.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Noun] Stress on the FIRST word. Danh từ ghép: trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
Don't forget your RAINcoat!
She bought a new RAINcoat.
He wore a yellow RAINcoat in the storm.
quizzes: Bring your __________ because it might rain this afternoon.
She put on her bright yellow __________ before going outside.
He forgot his __________ and got completely soaked.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Noun] Stress on the FIRST word. Danh từ ghép: trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
She poured tea into the TEAcup.
The TEAcup is very delicate.
He dropped the TEAcup on the floor.
quizzes: She carefully poured the hot tea into the small __________.
The pretty __________ was a gift from her grandmother.
He accidentally knocked the __________ off the table.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Noun] Stress on the FIRST word. Danh từ ghép: trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
My grandfather used a TYPEwriter.
The old TYPEwriter was in the museum.
She typed her letter on a TYPEwriter.
quizzes: Before computers, people used a __________ to write letters.
The old __________ in the museum still works.
She found a dusty __________ in her grandmother's attic.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Adjective: Adj + Past Participle] Stress on the SECOND part. Tính từ ghép [Tính từ + Phân từ quá khứ]: trọng âm thường rơi vào từ THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
He can be bad-TEMpered when he is hungry.
The bad-TEMpered man shouted at everyone.
Don't be bad-TEMpered about small things.
quizzes: He gets really __________ when he doesn't get enough sleep.
The __________ customer complained about everything.
She was __________ all morning because she missed breakfast.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Adjective: Adj + Past Participle] Stress on the SECOND part. Tính từ ghép [Tính từ + Phân từ quá khứ]: trọng âm thường rơi vào từ THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
That style is very old-FASHioned.
She likes old-FASHioned music.
The building has an old-FASHioned design.
quizzes: Some people prefer __________ music to modern pop songs.
That hairstyle looks a bit __________ these days.
The __________ building had a very classic and elegant design.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Adjective: Noun + Adjective] Stress on the FIRST part. Tính từ ghép [Danh từ + Tính từ]: trọng âm rơi vào từ THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
She felt HOMEsick at camp.
He was HOMEsick during his first week abroad.
Being HOMEsick is normal for students far from home.
quizzes: During her first week away, she felt very __________.
He called his parents every day because he was so __________.
Many students feel __________ when they first move to a new city.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Adjective: Noun + Adjective] Stress on the FIRST part. Tính từ ghép [Danh từ + Tính từ]: trọng âm rơi vào từ THỨ NHẤT.
vocabularies.example:
My jacket is WATERproof.
He bought WATERproof boots for hiking.
Is this phone WATERproof?
quizzes: She bought a __________ jacket before hiking in the rainy forest.
Make sure your bag is __________ before you go kayaking.
Is the new phone model completely __________?

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Verb] Stress on the SECOND part. Động từ ghép: trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
The river will overFLOW.
The sink overFLOWed because the drain was blocked.
Don't let the bucket overFLOW.
quizzes: The river tends to __________ during the rainy season.
The bathtub began to __________ because she forgot to turn off the tap.
Don't pour too much water or the cup will __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Compound Verb] Stress on the SECOND part. Động từ ghép: trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ HAI.
vocabularies.example:
Do you underSTAND the question?
I don't underSTAND this rule.
She underSTOOD the lesson very quickly.
quizzes: Please raise your hand if you don't __________ the question.
She found it hard to __________ the new grammar rule at first.
He spoke slowly to help us __________ his explanation.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Noun] When used as a Noun, stress is on the 1st syllable. Khi là Danh từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT: REcord.
vocabularies.example:
He broke the world REcord.
She kept a REcord of her expenses.
The team set a new REcord this year.
quizzes: She broke the school __________ for the 100-meter sprint.
He keeps a daily __________ of the weather.
The team set a new __________ for the most wins in a season.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Verb] When used as a Verb, stress is on the 2nd syllable. Khi là Động từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI: reCORD.
vocabularies.example:
Can you reCORD this programme?
She reCORDed the song beautifully.
He is reCORDing a video right now.
quizzes: Can you __________ the TV show for me tonight?
She will __________ her first song in the studio this Friday.
He is __________ a short video to post on his channel.

vocabularies.meaning: món quà / hiện tại (Danh từ/Tính từ)
vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Noun/Adj] When used as a Noun or Adjective, stress is on the 1st syllable. Khi là Danh từ/Tính từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT: PREsent.
vocabularies.example:
She gave him a birthday PREsent.
Let us focus on the PREsent moment.
All PREsent students must sign the list.
quizzes: She wrapped the __________ in bright red paper.
Let's not think about the past; focus on the __________ moment.
The teacher called the names of all __________ students.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Verb] When used as a Verb, stress is on the 2nd syllable. Khi là Động từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI: preSENT.
vocabularies.example:
She will preSENT her project today.
He preSENTed the award to the winner.
Can you preSENT your findings to the class?
quizzes: He was chosen to __________ the project to the judges.
She will __________ her science experiment tomorrow.
Can you __________ the results of your research to the class?

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Noun] When used as a Noun, stress is on the 1st syllable. Khi là Danh từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT: EXport.
vocabularies.example:
Coffee is a major EXport of Vietnam.
The EXport of rice helps the economy.
She works in the EXport department.
quizzes: Rice is one of Vietnam's most important __________s.
Coffee is a major __________ that earns a lot of money for the country.
She works in the __________ and import department of a big company.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Verb] When used as a Verb, stress is on the 2nd syllable. Khi là Động từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI: exPORT.
vocabularies.example:
Vietnam exPORTs a lot of coffee.
They exPORT goods to many countries.
The company exPORTs furniture to Europe.
quizzes: Vietnam __________ millions of tons of rice every year.
The company __________ its products to over 50 countries.
This factory __________ handmade furniture to Europe and America.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Noun] When used as a Noun, stress is on the 1st syllable. Khi là Danh từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT: OBject.
vocabularies.example:
What is that strange OBject?
She picked up the OBject from the floor.
The OBject in the box is very heavy.
quizzes: What is that mysterious __________ in the corner of the room?
She found a small __________ on the floor of the library.
The heavy __________ fell off the shelf with a loud bang.

vocabularies.definition: [Stress shift - Verb] When used as a Verb, stress is on the 2nd syllable. Khi là Động từ, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI: obJECT.
vocabularies.example:
She obJECTed to the new rule.
He obJECTed loudly during the meeting.
Why did you obJECT to my plan?
quizzes: Several students __________ to the change in the exam schedule.
He stood up to __________ when the unfair rule was announced.
Why did she __________ to the new seating arrangement?

grammars.structure: I. Quy tắc với từ 2 âm tiết - Danh từ & Tính từ
grammars.description:
Trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
Ngoại lệ: aLONE, aSLEEP, maCHINE, miSTAKE (từ bắt đầu bằng 'a' hoặc âm tiết 2 là nguyên âm dài).
grammars.example:
TAble, WAter, HAPpy, BUSy
Exception: aLONE, aSLEEP

grammars.structure: I. Quy tắc với từ 2 âm tiết - Động từ & Giới từ
grammars.description:
Trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
Ngoại lệ: Nếu âm tiết 2 là âm ngắn hoặc có đuôi -er, -en, -ow, -ish, -y thì trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
grammars.example:
beGIN, inVITE, aMONG, beTWEEN
Exception: OPen, HAPpen, ANSwer, FOLlow, FInish, CARry

grammars.structure: II. Quy tắc với từ 3 âm tiết trở lên - Danh từ & Tính từ
grammars.description:
- Nếu âm tiết thứ 2 chứa âm /ə/ hoặc /ɪ/: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
- Nếu âm tiết cuối chứa âm yếu và âm tiết 2 chứa nguyên âm dài/đôi: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.

grammars.structure: II. Quy tắc với từ 3 âm tiết trở lên - Động từ
grammars.description:
- Nếu âm tiết cuối chứa nguyên âm ngắn + 1 phụ âm: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
- Nếu âm tiết cuối chứa nguyên âm dài/đôi hoặc kết thúc bằng 2+ phụ âm: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết CUỐI (thứ ba).

grammars.structure: III. Hậu tố NHẬN trọng âm (-ee, -eer, -ese, -ique, -oo, -ain)
grammars.description:
Các hậu tố -ee, -eer, -ese, -ique, -esque, -ain, -oo tự nhận trọng âm.
Ngoại lệ: comMITtee, COFfee.
grammars.example: aGREE, engiNEER, VietnaMESE, uNIQUE, bamBOO, mainTAIN

grammars.structure: III. Hậu tố làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC (-ic, -ial, -ian, -ion, -ious, -ity, -logy...)
grammars.description: Các hậu tố -ic, -ics, -ial, -ian, -ion, -sion, -tion, -ious, -eous, -ity, -ety, -logy, -graphy làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết NGAY TRƯỚC chúng.
grammars.example: ecoNOmic, artiFIcial, muSIcian, inforMAtion, deLIcious, aBIlity, biOlogy

grammars.structure: III. Hậu tố làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ 3 TỪ CUỐI (-cy, -ty, -phy, -gy, -al, -ate, -ize, -fy)
grammars.description: Các hậu tố -cy, -ty, -phy, -gy, -al, -ate, -ize, -fy làm trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ ba tính từ cuối lên.
grammars.example: deMOcracy, phoTOgraphy, NAtional, comMUnicate, REcognize, BEAUtify

grammars.structure: III. Tiền tố & Hậu tố KHÔNG làm thay đổi trọng âm
grammars.description:
Tiền tố: un-, in-, im-, ir-, dis-, re-, over-, under-
Hậu tố: -ment, -ship, -ness, -er, -or, -hood, -ing, -ed, -en, -ful, -able, -less, -ly
Các affixes này không thay đổi trọng âm của từ gốc.
grammars.example:
HAPpy → unHAPpy | COver → disCOver
aGREE → aGREEment | MEANing → MEANingless

grammars.structure: IV. Từ Ghép - Danh từ ghép (Noun + Noun)
grammars.description: Trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ NHẤT.

grammars.structure: IV. Từ Ghép - Tính từ ghép [Adj/Noun + Past Participle]
grammars.description:
Tính từ ghép dạng [Tính từ + Phân từ quá khứ] hoặc [Danh từ + Phân từ quá khứ]: trọng âm rơi vào từ THỨ HAI.
Tính từ ghép dạng [Danh từ + Tính từ]: trọng âm rơi vào từ THỨ NHẤT.

grammars.structure: IV. Từ Ghép - Động từ ghép
grammars.description: Trọng âm rơi vào từ cấu tạo THỨ HAI.

grammars.structure: V. Trọng âm thay đổi theo từ loại (Noun/Adj → Âm 1 | Verb → Âm 2)
grammars.description:
Nhiều từ giữ nguyên cách viết nhưng thay đổi trọng âm tùy theo từ loại.
Danh từ/Tính từ: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ NHẤT.
Động từ: trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết THỨ HAI.
grammars.example:
REcord (n.) ↔ reCORD (v.)
PREsent (n./adj.) ↔ preSENT (v.)
EXport (n.) ↔ exPORT (v.)
OBject (n.) ↔ obJECT (v.)

sections.sectionName: Unit 2: Pronunciation of -ed ending (Phát âm đuôi -ed)

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪd/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /ɪd/ khi động từ kết thúc bằng âm /t/ hoặc /d/ (Mẹo nhớ: 'Tiền Đô' hoặc 'Tình Đầu').
vocabularies.example:
He wanted to go to the park yesterday.
She wanted a new bicycle for her birthday.
They wanted to know the answer.
quizzes: Yesterday, he __________ to play soccer with his friends.
She __________ to buy that beautiful dress, but it was too expensive.
We __________ to help him, but he said he was fine.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪd/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /ɪd/ khi động từ kết thúc bằng âm /t/ hoặc /d/ (Mẹo nhớ: 'Tiền Đô' hoặc 'Tình Đầu').
vocabularies.example:
I needed some help with my homework.
We needed more water for the trip.
She needed to buy some milk.
quizzes: I __________ some help with my math homework last night.
They __________ more time to finish their school project.
She __________ to see a doctor because she felt sick.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /k/ (chữ k - Mẹo: 'Khi').
vocabularies.example:
She looked out the window.
He looked at the picture on the wall.
We looked for the lost key.
quizzes: She __________ out the window and saw a beautiful bird.
He __________ at me and smiled warmly.
We __________ everywhere for the missing key.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /s/ (chữ s, ss, x, ce - Mẹo: 'Sang').
vocabularies.example:
He missed the school bus this morning.
She missed her parents when she went to camp.
We missed the beginning of the movie.
quizzes: He woke up late and __________ the school bus this morning.
She __________ her family very much when she was studying abroad.
They arrived late and unfortunately __________ the train.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /ʃ/ (chữ sh - Mẹo: 'Sông').
vocabularies.example:
She washed her hands before dinner.
He washed his bicycle yesterday.
They washed the dishes after eating.
quizzes: She __________ her hands thoroughly with soap before eating.
My father __________ his car yesterday morning.
We __________ all the dirty dishes after the party.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /p/ (chữ p - Mẹo: 'Phải').
vocabularies.example:
The bus stopped at the station.
He stopped talking when the teacher entered.
She stopped to buy some fruit.
quizzes: The car __________ suddenly when the light turned red.
Everyone __________ talking when the bell rang.
She __________ running because she was too tired.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /tʃ/ (chữ ch - Mẹo: 'Chờ').
vocabularies.example:
We watched a movie last night.
He watched the birds in the garden.
She watched her brother play football.
quizzes: We __________ a very funny cartoon on TV last night.
He __________ the birds flying in the sky for hours.
She __________ the game excitingly until the end.

vocabularies.meaning: tắm (quá khứ) - Lưu ý: Từ này âm cuối là /ð/ hữu thanh nên phát âm là /d/.
vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /d/] Lưu ý đặc biệt: Từ bathe /beɪð/ có âm cuối /ð/ (hữu thanh) nên phát âm là /d/. Còn từ bath /bɑːθ/ khi làm động từ ở quá khứ sẽ phát âm đuôi -ed là /t/ (Mẹo: 'Thu').
vocabularies.example:
She bathed the baby in warm water.
He bathed in the river yesterday.
She bathed her dog in the garden.
quizzes: She carefully __________ the baby in warm water.
We __________ in the cool sea water during our vacation.
He __________ his dirty dog after it played in the mud.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /t/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /t/ khi kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /f/ (chữ f, gh, ph - Mẹo: 'Phí').
vocabularies.example:
They laughed at the funny joke.
She laughed when she saw the puppy.
He laughed loudly.
quizzes: We all __________ out loud at his funny story.
She __________ happily when she saw her friends again.
The children __________ at the silly clown's performance.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /d/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /d/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh, không thuộc 2 nhóm trên).
vocabularies.example:
He played football with his friends.
She played the piano beautifully.
We played board games all afternoon.
quizzes: They __________ football in the park yesterday afternoon.
She __________ a beautiful song on the violin.
We __________ chess together last weekend.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /d/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /d/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh, không thuộc 2 nhóm trên).
vocabularies.example:
She loved reading fairy tales when she was young.
We loved the food at the restaurant.
He loved his grandparents very much.
quizzes: She __________ reading comic books when she was a child.
We really __________ the delicious food at the party.
He always __________ spending time in the countryside.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /d/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /d/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh, không thuộc 2 nhóm trên).
vocabularies.example:
He opened the door for his mother.
She opened the gift with excitement.
The shop opened early today.
quizzes: He kindly __________ the door for the elderly lady.
She __________ the box and found a beautiful necklace.
The new bookstore __________ for the first time yesterday.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /d/] Đuôi -ed phát âm là /d/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh, không thuộc 2 nhóm trên).
vocabularies.example:
She cleaned her bedroom yesterday.
We cleaned the classroom after school.
He cleaned his shoes before going out.
quizzes: She __________ her messy bedroom before her parents came home.
We __________ the kitchen after cooking a big dinner.
He __________ his glasses with a soft cloth.

grammars.structure: 1. Nhóm phát âm là /ɪd/
grammars.description:
Dành cho động từ kết thúc bằng âm /t/ hoặc /d/.
Mẹo nhớ: 'Tiền Đô' (T - Đ) hoặc 'Tình Đầu'.

grammars.structure: 2. Nhóm phát âm là /t/
grammars.description:
Dành cho các động từ kết thúc bằng các âm vô thanh: /k/, /s/, /ʃ/, /p/, /tʃ/, /θ/, /f/.
Mẹo nhớ 1: 'Khi Sang Sông Phải Chờ Thu Phí'
Mẹo nhớ 2: 'Chính Phủ Phát Sách Không Thèm Share'
grammars.example: looked (/lʊkt/), missed (/mɪst/), washed (/wɒʃt/), stopped (/stɒpt/), watched (/wɒtʃt/), bathed (/bɑːθt/), laughed (/lɑːft/)

grammars.structure: 3. Nhóm phát âm là /d/
grammars.description: Dành cho các động từ kết thúc bằng các âm còn lại (áp dụng phương pháp loại trừ, không nằm trong nhóm 1 và nhóm 2).

sections.sectionName: Unit 3: Pronunciation of -s/-es ending (Phát âm đuôi -s/-es)

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /s/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /s/ khi từ kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /θ/ (chữ th - Mẹo: 'Thời').
vocabularies.example:
He spent three months in London.
There are twelve months in a year.
She has been learning English for six months.
quizzes: We have been planning this trip for many __________.
There are twelve __________ in a single year.
The baby is now ten __________ old.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /s/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /s/ khi từ kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /p/ (chữ p - Mẹo: 'phong').
vocabularies.example:
We need four cups of flour.
She washed the cups and saucers.
There are two cups of tea on the table.
quizzes: Please bring three __________ of water for our guests.
She washed all the coffee __________ and put them away.
He has won many gold __________ in soccer tournaments.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /s/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /s/ khi từ kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /k/ (chữ k - Mẹo: 'kiến').
vocabularies.example:
She loves reading books.
These books are very heavy.
Put the books back on the shelf.
quizzes: The library has thousands of interesting __________ to read.
Please put these textbooks and notebook __________ back on the shelf.
He has read three __________ this month.

vocabularies.meaning: cười, tiếng cười (số nhiều/chia ngôi ba)
vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /s/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /s/ khi từ kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /f/ (chữ f, gh, ph phát âm là /f/ - Mẹo: 'phương').
vocabularies.example:
He always laughs at my jokes.
She laughs very loudly.
Everyone laughs when the clown performs.
quizzes: He always __________ when he watches comedy shows.
She __________ so much that her face turns red.
No one __________ at his silly jokes anymore.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /s/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /s/ khi từ kết thúc bằng âm vô thanh /t/ (chữ t - Mẹo: 'tây').
vocabularies.example:
She has three pet cats.
Cats love chasing mice.
My cats are sleeping on the sofa.
quizzes: My sister loves pet __________ more than dogs.
The two __________ are playing with a ball of yarn.
Stray __________ sometimes sleep on our porch.

vocabularies.meaning: những củ khoai tây - Lưu ý: Mặc dù viết đuôi -es sau 'o' nhưng phát âm là /z/ do kết thúc bằng nguyên âm.
vocabularies.definition: [Lưu ý phát âm /z/] Mặc dù từ kết thúc bằng chữ 'o' và thêm -es, nhưng về mặt âm học, âm cuối cùng là nguyên âm /əʊ/ (hữu thanh) nên phát âm đuôi -es là /z/ chứ không phải /ɪz/. Tuy nhiên, mẹo nhớ chữ cái 'o' ('Ông') thường được xếp vào nhóm thêm 'es'.
vocabularies.example:
We need to buy some potatoes.
She peeled the potatoes for the soup.
He planted potatoes in the garden.
quizzes: We bought a big bag of fresh __________ from the market.
She mashed the cooked __________ with butter and milk.
Are you going to bake these __________ for dinner?

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng chữ s (Mẹo: 'Sáu').
vocabularies.example:
The school buses are yellow.
Many buses pass by our house.
We waited for the buses for an hour.
quizzes: All the school __________ are parked in the yard.
Are there any city __________ running late at night?
We have to wait here because the __________ are delayed.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng chữ ss (Mẹo: 'sungsức').
vocabularies.example:
She has English classes on Mondays.
All classes start at 8 AM.
The school has twenty classes in total.
quizzes: I enjoy my science and art __________ the most.
Our morning __________ usually finish at eleven thirty.
The teacher manages three different __________ of students.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng đuôi ge (phát âm là âm gió /dʒ/ - Mẹo: 'ghé').
vocabularies.example:
Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
She squeezed three oranges for juice.
These oranges are very sweet.
quizzes: Eating __________ every day is good for your health.
She bought a dozen fresh __________ to make juice.
How much do these sweet __________ cost per kilo?

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng chữ c/ce (phát âm là âm gió /s/ - Mẹo: 'công').
vocabularies.example:
We visited many beautiful places.
There are no empty places left.
She loves exploring new places.
quizzes: We visited many historic __________ during our trip to Europe.
There are still some empty __________ at the dining table.
He has traveled to many interesting __________ around the world.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng chữ z (Mẹo: 'ziên').
vocabularies.example:
We have weekly quizzes in English.
She did well on all her math quizzes.
The teacher prepares short quizzes for us.
quizzes: Our science teacher gives us short __________ every Friday.
I need to study hard to pass these vocabulary __________.
How many __________ did you have to take this semester?

vocabularies.meaning: những chiếc đồng hồ / xem (ngôi ba số ít)
vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng đuôi ch (phát âm là âm gió /tʃ/ - Mẹo: 'chạy').
vocabularies.example:
He watches television after school.
She has two beautiful watches.
My father watches the news every evening.
quizzes: He always __________ his favorite cartoon show on Sundays.
She collection includes several vintage __________.
My mother __________ the cooking program to learn new recipes.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng chữ x (phát âm là âm gió /ks/ - Mẹo: 'xe').
vocabularies.example:
We packed the toys in cardboard boxes.
There are three heavy boxes in the hall.
Can you help me carry these boxes?
quizzes: Please help me pack these books into the cardboard __________.
There are several empty __________ in the garage.
We stored all our old clothes in plastic __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /ɪz/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /ɪz/ khi từ kết thúc bằng đuôi sh (phát âm là âm gió /ʃ/ - Mẹo: 'sh').
vocabularies.example:
She washed the dishes after dinner.
They served many traditional dishes.
We need more clean dishes for the party.
quizzes: It is your turn to wash the __________ after dinner tonight.
The restaurant serves many delicious traditional __________.
We laid out all the plates and __________ on the buffet table.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /z/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /z/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh như /ɡ/).
vocabularies.example:
They have two friendly dogs.
Dogs are very loyal animals.
I hear dogs barking outside.
quizzes: We saw three big __________ playing in the park.
__________ are known to be very loyal companions.
The neighbor's __________ always bark when someone walks past.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /z/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /z/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh như /n/).
vocabularies.example:
I need some blue pens.
He has many pens in his pencil case.
These pens write very smoothly.
quizzes: Could you lend me one of your blue __________?
She has a collection of colorful gel __________ on her desk.
I always keep two spare __________ in my backpack.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /z/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /z/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh như /ɡ/).
vocabularies.example:
They carried heavy bags of groceries.
Put your bags in the locker.
We bought some new school bags.
quizzes: The children left their heavy school __________ in the classroom.
She carried two plastic __________ full of fresh vegetables.
All passenger __________ must go through security check.

vocabularies.definition: [Nhóm /z/] Đuôi -s/-es phát âm là /z/ cho các trường hợp còn lại (âm cuối hữu thanh như /m/).
vocabularies.example:
The house has five rooms.
Clean your rooms before going out.
These hotel rooms are very quiet.
quizzes: Their new house is big and has many __________.
Please clean your __________ before going out to play.
The conference __________ are located on the second floor.

grammars.structure: 1. Nhóm phát âm là /s/
grammars.description:
Áp dụng cho các từ kết thúc bằng các âm/chữ cái vô thanh: th, p, k, f, t.
Mẹo nhớ: 'Thời phong kiến phương tây' (th - p - k - f/gh/ph - t).

grammars.structure: 2. Nhóm phát âm là /iz/
grammars.description:
Áp dụng cho các từ kết thúc bằng các âm gió, chữ cái: s, ss, ge, c/ce, z, ch, x, sh.
Mẹo nhớ: 'Ông Sáu sungsức ghé công ziên chạy xe sh' (o - s - ss - ge - c - z - ch - x - sh).
grammars.example:
buses (/ˈbʌsɪz/), classes (/ˈklɑːsɪz/), oranges (/ˈɒrɪndʒɪz/), places (/ˈpleɪsɪz/), quizzes (/ˈkwɪzɪz/), watches (/ˈwɒtʃɪz/), boxes (/ˈbɒksɪz/), dishes (/ˈdɪʃɪz/)
*Lưu ý: từ kết thúc bằng 'o' như potatoes, tomatoes phát âm là /z/.

grammars.structure: 3. Nhóm phát âm là /z/
grammars.description: Áp dụng cho tất cả các trường hợp còn lại (kết thúc bằng các nguyên âm và phụ âm hữu thanh khác: b, d, g, l, m, n, r, v, y...).

grammars.structure: BÀI TẬP NHANH CHO BẠN
grammars.description: Hãy thử áp dụng quy tắc/mẹo nhớ bên trên để phân loại cách phát âm đuôi s/es của các từ sau:
grammars.example:
- books → Kết thúc bằng k ('kiến') → Phát âm là /s/
- boxes → Kết thúc bằng x ('xe') → Phát âm là /iz/
- cats → Kết thúc bằng t ('tây') → Phát âm là /s/
- pens → Không thuộc nhóm 1 và 2 ('còn lại') → Phát âm là /z/
- watches → Kết thúc bằng ch ('chạy') → Phát âm là /iz/

sections.sectionName: Unit 4: Pronunciation of Vowels (Phát âm nguyên âm)

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ A phát âm là /æ/] Thường gặp trong các từ có 1 âm tiết, kết thúc bằng phụ âm.
vocabularies.example:
The cat is sleeping on the mat.
I have a black cat.
Cats can see in the dark.
quizzes: My pet __________ loves to sleep on my lap.
A small grey __________ ran across the street.
Do you prefer __________s or dogs?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ A phát âm là /eɪ/] Rất phổ biến khi đi với cấu trúc: a + phụ âm + e (âm e ở cuối câm).
vocabularies.example:
She baked a chocolate cake.
Would you like a piece of cake?
This cake is delicious.
quizzes: We bought a big birthday __________ for my sister.
Would you like another slice of __________?
She taught me how to bake a strawberry __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ A phát âm là /ɑː/] Thường gặp khi chữ 'a' đứng trước chữ 'r' (ar).
vocabularies.example:
He drives a blue car.
We parked the car outside.
She washed her car yesterday.
quizzes: My uncle bought a brand new red __________.
We travelled to the beach by __________.
Can you help me wash the __________ this weekend?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ A phát âm là /ɔː/] Thường gặp khi chữ 'a' đứng trước 'll', 'lk', 'w', 'u'.
vocabularies.example:
He is very tall for his age.
There are tall trees in the park.
She is taller than her brother.
quizzes: He is the __________est boy in our classroom.
The city has many __________ buildings.
She is not short; she is actually quite __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ A phát âm là /ə/] Khi chữ 'a' nằm ở âm tiết không nhận trọng âm.
vocabularies.example:
What is this book about?
It takes about ten minutes.
Tell me about your family.
quizzes: This story is __________ a brave young knight.
We arrived at school at __________ seven o'clock.
What are you thinking __________?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ E phát âm là /e/] Thường gặp trong các từ ngắn kết thúc bằng phụ âm.
vocabularies.example:
Write your name with a pen.
Can I borrow your pen?
I lost my red pen.
quizzes: You should write the exam in blue __________.
I need to buy a new black __________ today.
May I borrow your __________ for a second?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ E phát âm là /iː/] Thường gặp khi 'e' đứng ở cuối từ ngắn hoặc cấu trúc 'ee', 'ea'.
vocabularies.example:
I can see the sea from here.
Nice to see you again.
Did you see the soccer match?
quizzes: I can __________ a beautiful rainbow in the sky.
It is so nice to __________ you after a long time.
Did you __________ where I placed my glasses?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ E phát âm là /ɪ/] Thường gặp trong các tiền tố như be-, de-, re-.
vocabularies.example:
Let's begin the lesson.
When does the film begin?
The show is about to begin.
quizzes: We will __________ our class at eight o'clock.
When did the rain __________ to fall?
Please stand up before we __________ the presentation.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ I phát âm là /ɪ/] Thường gặp trong các từ ngắn kết thúc bằng phụ âm.
vocabularies.example:
The pig is eating food.
He drew a pink pig.
They raise pigs on the farm.
quizzes: The farmer fed the hungry __________s in the barn.
A baby __________ is called a piglet.
She loves the cartoon character of the little pink __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ I phát âm là /aɪ/] Rất phổ biến trong cấu trúc i + phụ âm + e, hoặc trước 'nd', 'ld'.
vocabularies.example:
Let's fly a kite in the park.
He made a colorful kite.
The kite flew high in the sky.
quizzes: The children are flying a red __________ in the windy field.
He built a beautiful paper __________ with his father.
The __________ got stuck in the tall tree branch.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ I phát âm là /ɜː/] Thường gặp khi chữ 'i' đứng trước chữ 'r' (ir).
vocabularies.example:
A bird is singing in the tree.
I saw a colorful bird.
Birds fly south for winter.
quizzes: A beautiful little __________ was singing outside my window.
She fed breadcrumbs to the __________s in the park.
Which kind of __________ is the largest in the world?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ O phát âm là /ɒ/] Thường gặp trong các từ ngắn.
vocabularies.example:
The dog is barking loudly.
I have a friendly dog.
He walked his dog in the park.
quizzes: Our pet __________ always runs to greet us at the door.
He took his __________ for a walk around the block.
The wild __________ barked at the stranger.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ O phát âm là /əʊ/] Thường gặp trong cấu trúc o + phụ âm + e, hoặc khi đứng cuối từ ngắn.
vocabularies.example:
I want to go home now.
Make yourself at home.
She stayed at home yesterday.
quizzes: I feel so comfortable when I am at __________.
What time do you usually get __________ from school?
They bought a lovely new __________ near the park.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ O phát âm là /ʌ/] Thường gặp trong một số từ đặc biệt thông dụng.
vocabularies.example:
He is my eldest son.
They have a son and a daughter.
Her son is a student.
quizzes: Their eldest __________ is studying at university.
She is very proud of her young __________'s achievements.
They are blessed to have a healthy baby __________.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ O phát âm là /ɔː/] Thường gặp khi 'o' đứng trước 'r' (or).
vocabularies.example:
He has short hair.
It was a short story.
She is short but active.
quizzes: We took a __________ break after the test.
She prefers to wear __________ pants in summer.
The days are __________er in the winter season.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ O phát âm là /uː/] Trong một số từ đặc biệt hoặc cụm 'oo'.
vocabularies.example:
I love Vietnamese food.
We bought some food for the party.
Cats need healthy food.
quizzes: Vietnamese __________ is very popular worldwide.
We need to buy some fresh __________ from the supermarket.
Do not waste __________ because many people are hungry.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ U phát âm là /ʌ/] Thường gặp trong các từ ngắn.
vocabularies.example:
Drink a cup of tea.
She washed the coffee cup.
I need a cup of water.
quizzes: He drank a hot __________ of cocoa before bed.
She carefully placed the porcelain __________ on the table.
Can I have a __________ of coffee, please?

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ U phát âm là /juː/] Thường gặp trong cấu trúc u + phụ âm + e, hoặc đầu một số từ.
vocabularies.example:
What a cute baby!
She has a cute puppy.
He wrote a cute message.
quizzes: The baby has a very __________ and happy smile.
She bought a __________ little teddy bear for her cousin.
He has a __________ kitten that loves to play with wool.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ U phát âm là /u/ ngắn - /ʊ/] Cách phát âm đặc biệt.
vocabularies.example:
Put the keys on the table.
Where did you put my pen?
She put on her coat and left.
quizzes: Please __________ your books back in your backpack.
Where did you __________ my glasses, Mom?
He __________ the box on the top shelf.

vocabularies.definition: [Chữ U phát âm là /ɜː/] Thường gặp khi 'u' đứng trước chữ 'r' (ur).
vocabularies.example:
Turn left at the corner.
It's your turn now.
He turned the handle slowly.
quizzes: Please __________ right when you reach the post office.
It is now your __________ to roll the dice.
Don't forget to __________ off the lights when leaving.

grammars.structure: 1. Sự biến hóa của chữ 'A'
grammars.description:
- /æ/: Từ 1 âm tiết kết thúc bằng phụ âm (cat, hat).
- /eɪ/: Cấu trúc a + phụ âm + e câm (cake, name).
- /ɑː/: Đứng trước chữ 'r' (car, star).
- /ɔː/: Đứng trước 'll', 'lk', 'w', 'u' (tall, water).
- /ə/: Âm tiết không nhận trọng âm (about, banana).

grammars.structure: 2. Sự biến hóa của chữ 'E'
grammars.description:
- /e/: Từ ngắn kết thúc bằng phụ âm (pen, bed).
- /iː/: Đứng cuối từ ngắn hoặc cấu trúc ee, ea (she, see, meat).
- /ɪ/: Tiền tố be-, de-, re- (begin, return).
- E câm: Đứng cuối từ, làm nguyên âm trước kéo dài (like, make).

grammars.structure: 3. Sự biến hóa của chữ 'I'
grammars.description:
- /ɪ/: Từ ngắn kết thúc bằng phụ âm (pig, sit).
- /aɪ/: Cấu trúc i + phụ âm + e, hoặc trước nd, ld (kite, kind, child).
- /ɜː/: Đứng trước chữ 'r' (bird, girl, first).

grammars.structure: 4. Sự biến hóa của chữ 'O'
grammars.description:
- /ɒ/: Từ ngắn (dog, hot).
- /əʊ/: Cấu trúc o + phụ âm + e hoặc cuối từ ngắn (home, go).
- /ʌ/: Từ đặc biệt (son, love, month).
- /ɔː/: Đứng trước 'r' (short, morning).
- /uː/: Từ đặc biệt hoặc cụm 'oo' (do, food).

grammars.structure: 5. Sự biến hóa của chữ 'U'
grammars.description:
- /ʌ/: Từ ngắn (cup, sun, bus).
- /juː/: Cấu trúc u + phụ âm + e hoặc đầu một số từ (cute, music).
- /ʊ/: Cách phát âm đặc biệt (put, pull, full).
- /ɜː/: Đứng trước chữ 'r' (turn, burn, hurt).
